column5: DESKTOP DONE; THE SMALL-SCREEN TIER IS NOW BUILT (5 of its 6 frames), 1 DECLINED AS A RIVAL. Desktop verdicts (graph panel 9142-18315, manual bet panel 9137-13564, live-bets header 9142-19454, Auto 9142-16809, Auto Advanced 9142-19197) are carried forward: every desktop metric moved from `lg:`-only to unprefixed, and each child of the bet column now carries an explicit `lg:order-N` reproducing the verified desktop sequence exactly (tabs, currency, amount, cashout, profit, CTA, auto, stats, bets). ★ TWO DESKTOP-VISIBLE CHANGES, both toward the frame and both worth a re-look: (a) the CTA, auto-play and stats blocks each carried `p-3 border-b border-green-coal-100` with NO `lg:border-b-0`, so desktop drew three divider rules and 12px of extra padding that neither 9137-13564 nor any small frame draws — the panel is a gap-16 stack with no rules — and they are removed; (b) live-bets ROWS are rebuilt to the frame's three columns (name | multiplier | stake) with cashed-out rows carried by #17F9B4 text instead of a row fill. The live-bets HEADER, which is what 9142-19454 was verified on, is unchanged and keeps its `lg:border-b`. BUILT THIS PASS: the widget had ONE responsive branch in ~3,950 lines (a `lg:hidden` swapping the half-stake chip label) plus FOUR controls that were `hidden lg:flex`, i.e. INVISIBLE below 1024px with no mobile equivalent - Manual/Auto tabs, currency selector, Balance row, Potential Profit. A phone player could not switch to Auto at all. Now: the panel REORDERS below `lg` per 9156-1198/1371/1558 (52px CTA FIRST, Manual/Auto tabs LAST - the inverse of desktop), and ★ THE TWO SMALL TIERS DISAGREE ON THE CTA so "below lg" is NOT one rule: the 375 frames put the CTA at the very top above the bet amount, while the 768 frame 9003-96041 puts it BETWEEN the Balance row and Auto Cashout - the CTA, amount and currency blocks each carry an `md:` override for that, and nothing else needs one; Auto Cashout and Potential Profit pair into two equal columns through a `lg:contents` wrapper, so desktop keeps them as separate stacked children with no duplicated markup; auto-play settings become label-above-42px-field instead of a label with a stub input; the live-bets card is a FIXED 200px scroller that KEEPS ALL THREE COLUMNS (name | multiplier | stake) rather than collapsing, because 9156-1290 clips six rows inside it rather than stacking them. Sub-44px controls carry `no-min-size` per control at the measured Figma height (42px inputs/chips/tracks, 34px pills, and both Radix `Switch`es - Radix renders a `<button role=switch>`, so BOTH `max-width:768px` blocks in index.css were inflating the frame's 21px toggle to 44px). index.css untouched; the 52px CTAs deliberately keep the floor. Tablet width is 9003-96041's, measured off its own render (panel x150..617 = 468px centred; graph card x30..737), NOT 9003-98680's (panel x173..594 = 422px) - see the deferred row. ★ MULTIPLIER-CONSTANT: the payout-level bug is NOT open - it was fixed 2026-07-29 and this pass re-verified the fix holds. The POINTS curve animates from the server's own `growthK` (AviatorGamePro.tsx:1049), and the SHARED SKAI rail's 0.15/sec display AGREES with both places that settle it (game-settlement/index.ts:14247 `Math.exp(elapsedSeconds * 0.15)`, and `ln(crash_point)/0.15` in 20260722130000). What WAS still wrong is the X-AXIS: `xAxisLabels` hardcoded 0.15 in BOTH its multiplier-to-seconds and seconds-to-multiplier conversions, so on the POINTS rail - currently the ONLY playable one - every tick was mislabelled by 2.5x (it claimed 2.00x arrives at 4.6s where the server reaches it at 11.6s). It now reads the open round's own constant, so neither rail is hardcoded. ★ ONE RESIDUAL DISPLAY/RAIL DIVERGENCE LEFT, NOT FIXED because it is latent and the fix is not obvious: crashLiveRoundService.ts:29 caps the DISPLAYED shared-rail multiplier at `MAX_MULTIPLIER = 100`, but the SQL rail's crash point has no such cap - at 5% edge P(C >= 100x) = 0.95/100, about 1 round in 105 - so in those rounds the readout pins at 100x while the server keeps settling from its own elapsed time. It errs toward paying MORE than displayed rather than less, and SKAI is gated off, so nothing is mis-paid today; it becomes real the moment real-money play is enabled. The POINTS path is already correct here (it caps at the server's own `maxMultCenti`, 10,000x). ★ THREE ★ CLAIMS FROM THE PRIOR NOTE ARE STALE AND ARE RETIRED, each re-checked this pass: (1) the SKAI rail's 1% edge was restored to 5% by 20260731120000_restore_crash_house_edge_5pct.sql:52; (2) `crashSettleAbandoned` is no longer imported by nothing - points-game/index.ts:197,4875 wires it; (3) POINTS stakes are no longer silently forfeit when the unrelated shared round crashes - points-game/index.ts:4844-4890 sweeps the stranded round and reveals its seed before opening a new one. Practice-mode toggle still omitted per the standing product call (both 768 frames draw it). NOT render-verified in a browser this pass: the tier is built to numerically measured frame metrics, so no small-screen frame is claimed `match`.
